items.title: William "Big Bill" Thompson Interview, 1961-03-01
items.q: No, I don't remember him good.

ctx.x: His brother often played very good too. Eddie Loomis. Remember Eddie Loomis?
No, I don't remember him good.
He could play pretty good. I don't remember him. Now, you were speaking about Big Kato and Little Kato.
